items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Parker and June Christy on the front line... He would play, and then he would back her when she sang.

ctx.x: Anyway, everybody was planning for the big night at Jack's Basket Room after-hours. And Leroy had fixed him a big steak and everything, and he was already feelin' good -- he had fresh clothes and everything, heh-heh. And when we got to Jack's Basket Room, the place was loaded. Everybody was waiting on Charlie Parker. In the audience that night I remember was Preston Foster...no, Robert Preston, that's the one, and Ava Gardner and Turon(?) Bey(?), and all kind of musicians and celebrities. Stan Kenton's band was…
This first set that he played on was with Jimmy Bunn on piano; Jo Jones, Daddy Jo The Drummer, on drums; and Curtis Counce I think was playing the bass; and June Christy
